tracks.title: 四點落梨山 Sì Tiám Lo̍h Lî-san
tracks.mood: giddy, wide awake and racing the clock, a mountain descent against the auction bell
tracks.subject: a young woman who takes over her father's cabbage truck the night his back gives out, loads four hundred crates of high-mountain cabbage in Lishan at three in the morning and races down the switchbacks through Yilan at first light to make the seven o'clock auction at the Taipei fruit and vegetable wholesale market, her mother phoning every hour and one cabbage bouncing off the back on a bend
